statements.text: ROSIM AS is a registered legal form AS with organisation number 988185701, founded on 2005-04-11 and registered on 2005-05-21.
The company operates in the industry code 58.290 for publishing other software, with a registry employee count of 12.

The company's website reports that ROSIM are experts on water flow measurement and network modeling, providing insight into stormwater and wastewater systems, precipitation measurement, and extraneous water.

Revenue increased from 25,957,519 NOK to 27,000,247 NOK between the periods 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31 and 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, but then decreased to 26,065,153 NOK for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
Geir Johan Lindholm serves as the daglig leder and styremedlem, while Gorm Andreas Pedersen is the styrets leder.
